name: XiongjieDai/GPU-Benchmarks-on-LLM-Inference — llama.cpp on NVIDIA A100 PCIe 80GB et al. (RunPod, LLaMA-3 8B/70B Q4_K_M + F16, 1024-token generate + prompt-eval)
notes: llama.cpp built with cuBLAS (make LLAMA_CUBLAS=1, era ~May 2024 for the runpod table).
